help.title: How the catalog works
help.families: Russian First is tuned for Russian speech. Code Switch is tuned for Russian mixed with English technical terms. RuEn is the general Russian/English multilingual Whisper family.
help.weights: Light, Medium and Heavy describe disk and memory cost. MLX / FP16 uses Metal on Apple Silicon; CTranslate2 Int8 runs efficiently on CPU, while Int8 / Float16 targets CUDA. Nothing downloads until you press Download.
help.updates: Scan Hugging Face accepts only compatible CTranslate2 repositories with a usable model.bin and never replaces the current model automatically.
